decision.label: ANSWER
decision.response: Yes, it is the right time to apply the remaining urea. The manual recommends applying half of the urea at planting and the remaining half 30-45 days after planting. Since you planted 38 days ago, you are within the recommended window.
decision.justification: Section 3.8 (Page 12) states: 'Both fertilizers are applied for Garlic at the rate of 200 kg/ha NPS and 150 kg/ha Urea. The whole amount of phosphorus fertilizer is applied once during planting, whereas half rate of urea is applied during planting and remaining is applied 30-45 days after planting.' The farmer's planting date of 38 days ago falls within this 30-45 day range.
